subject: Question about your service
text:
Hello all,

I am reaching out because I would like some details about your translation service before I consider using it next month. I work as a freelance writer, and I usually need short, accurate edits rather than full packages.

If it is not too much trouble, I have one small favor: could you send a simple outline of your pricing, typical turnaround, and whether revisions are included? A brief answer will be enough.

For context, I prefer written updates by email and have tried to keep requests straightforward. If any part needs explanation, that is fine.

I appreciate the time you have already spent reading this, and I look forward to your reply.
